$comment: Hand-derived expectations for test/fixtures/artifacts/*.rgy1, read by lib/rgy1/layout.test.ts with its own byte walker rather than the reader. Offsets follow docs/rgy1.md: directory at align8(32 + headerLength), first payload at align8(directory + 24 × sections), each section at a multiple of 8. The bit positions are the spec's key formula applied by hand: AUS = ((0×26+20)×26+18) = 538, FRA = ((5×26+17)×26+0) = 3822, GBR = ((6×26+1)×26+17) = 4099, DDR = ((3×26+3)×26+17) = 2123, LHR = ((11×26+7)×26+17) = 7635. The relation holds the fixture's three airports with an ISO country: AUS and SFO in US, LHR in GB; FRA's country is a source extension and PRX and ZZZ have none.
